tests.title: Test6 — Visualization Suite (Capability)
tests.prompt: The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing price data. Create visualisations showing the main factors affecting house prices. Generate: 1. a price distribution histogram, 2. an area vs price scatter plot, 3. a bar chart of average price by furnishing status. Save each chart as a PNG file in the workspace and explain the key insight from each chart.
tests.model_output: Generated price_distribution.png, area_vs_price.png, average_price_by_furnishing.png with a written insight for each chart.
notes: All 3 PNGs confirmed present in agent_outputs.zip, matching filenames exactly as named in the model's own response text.

tests.title: Test8 — Executive Slide Deck (Capability)
tests.prompt: You are a data analyst. The file data/housing_dataset.csv contains housing market data. Analyse the dataset end-to-end and create an executive slide deck. The deck should include: dataset overview, important trends, visualisations, key drivers of price, and business recommendations. Save the final presentation as a PowerPoint file called housing_analysis.pptx in the workspace.
tests.model_output: Generated housing_analysis.pptx covering dataset overview (545 records), key trends (area/bathrooms as scale correlation, main road + furnishing as premium factors), key drivers (Area r=0.54, Bathrooms r=0.52, amenity impacts), delivered via [media:housing_analysis.pptx].
notes: pptx confirmed present in agent_outputs.zip alongside a charts/ subfolder (4 PNGs: amenities_impact.png, furnishing_impact.png, price_vs_area.png, rooms_impact.png) used to build the deck.
